Zoom in and click a parcel footprint to emphasize every mapped footprint identified as being part of a project, or common development (based on taxpayer/owner information). title: Worth Municipality Projects
text:
Projects in Worth
Counts and values include only PINs within this region. A project may extend into another region, so regional project counts are not additive. Unassigned PINs are excluded from project totals. FMV means estimated fair market value. Incentive PINs are 2024 classes 600-899. FMV is summed only over known 2024 values; an entirely missing valuation remains missing. The project identifier uses Appellant, falling back to Key PIN. Last Year of Paid Taxbill lists each distinct latest year in which a PIN had a bill greater than $0 during 2006-2024; it does not confirm payment. PINs without a positive bill in that history are identified separately. TIF counts use 2024 PIN-to-TIF membership records regardless of payment or increment, rather than positive distributions. Missing 2024 records are not counted as known TIF members.

title: Worth Municipality Projects
text:
Sources and coverage
Historical universe: commercial_industrial_pin_universe_2026_09_21.csv, derived from comm_ind_PINs_ever_2006to2024.csv. Classification and FMV: 2024 observations in that underlying extract. Project assignments: project_assignments_phase7_2026_09_22.csv (phase-7 key PIN). Appellants and appeal years: latest tax-year records for each PIN in borappeals_UPDATED.csv, including all ties. Names come only from BOR records for that PIN, with no fallback to reviewed names. Buyer names come from the assignment file; purchase years are matched by PIN, sale document, and buyer in Assessor_Parcel_Sales_20250105.csv. Unmatched years are shown as unavailable. Last positive bills use the 2006-2024 history, and TIF membership uses tif_record_present in the 2024 extract. Class descriptions: class_dict_expanded.csv. Geometry: 2024 footprints from ptaxsim-2024.0.0.db.
PIN totals come from the tabular universe, independently of map coverage. Footprints are drawn once even when multiple PINs share the same ten-digit identifier. Assignment-review counts identify flagged records; absence of a flag does not certify an assignment. Directory and PIN-search pages may still use older data vintages.

title: East Hazelcrest Municipality Projects
text:
Projects in East Hazelcrest
Counts and values include only PINs within this region. A project may extend into another region, so regional project counts are not additive. Unassigned PINs are excluded from project totals. FMV means estimated fair market value. Incentive PINs are 2024 classes 600-899. FMV is summed only over known 2024 values; an entirely missing valuation remains missing. The project identifier uses Appellant, falling back to Key PIN. Last Year of Paid Taxbill lists each distinct latest year in which a PIN had a bill greater than $0 during 2006-2024; it does not confirm payment. PINs without a positive bill in that history are identified separately. TIF counts use 2024 PIN-to-TIF membership records regardless of payment or increment, rather than positive distributions. Missing 2024 records are not counted as known TIF members.

title: East Hazelcrest Municipality Projects
text:
Sources and coverage
Historical universe: commercial_industrial_pin_universe_2026_09_21.csv, derived from comm_ind_PINs_ever_2006to2024.csv. Classification and FMV: 2024 observations in that underlying extract. title: PINs to Projects
text: This website documents how individual Property Index Numbers (PINs) were grouped into larger commercial and industrial property projects.

title: PINs to Projects
section: Examaple: Different ways to define a project
text:
Examaple: Different ways to define a project
These four views of Matteson near I-57 and Lincoln Highway illustrate how manually coded projects, assessor valuation worksheets, and CMAP developments group properties differently. None of them are wrong, but they are different. They also are snapshots from different points in time.





Manually coded projects: 85 projects representing 163 PINs. Projects defined by keypin variable in keypins_checked_MAINFILE.xlsx







Valuation worksheets: 140 PINs, 88 distinct key PINs, and 22 unmatched PINs.


Matteson is located in Rich Township. KeyPINs were from the 2023 Reassessment of the South Triad.





CMAP developments: another way to group the same area.


See CMAP’s Development Database for another great resource on developments in Cook, DuPage, Kane, Kendall, Lake, McHenry, and Will County.





Google aerial screenshot: the physical setting for comparison.

title: How PINs Relate to Projects
text:
A PIN identifies an individual tax parcel. A single commercial or industrial development may contain several parcels and therefore several PINs.
A project is the broader property grouping created from the available appeal records, sale documents, valuation worksheets, and parcel proximity. The manually assigned key PIN identifies that grouped project.

title: How PINs Relate to Projects
text:
Geographic organization
Each PIN is associated with a municipality and a township. The detailed reports are rendered by township because the parcel analysis was written around township boundaries and because there are substantially fewer townships than municipalities.
Municipal boundaries and township boundaries do not always match. A municipality may therefore appear in more than one township report. The municipality directory lists every relevant township report rather than pretending each municipality belongs to exactly one township.
